'''Mercedes Vanadiaz''' was the wingman of [[Jerrod Lourdas]]. She was cocky and eager to rise in the ranks of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. Her bossy attitude gave some a poor image of herself, especially to Jerrod Lourdas.

==History==
Mercedes joined Jerrod when patrolling the sectors [[Sector 16|16]], [[Sector 17 (Arda I)|17]], and [[Sector 18 (Arda I)|18]].<ref name="OAA1" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Onslaught at Arda I]]'' {{1st}}
